content.title: New Commercial Buildings, Commercial Additions & Multi-Family Building Permits
content.summary: This article provides guidance on applying for building permits for new commercial buildings, commercial additions, and multi-family projects in the City of Arvada. It outlines required documents, the application process, review timelines, fees, inspections, and certificate of occupancy requirements.
content.eligibility: Commercial permits are issued to Licensed Contractors. Permits without sub-contractors listed will be placed on hold.

steps.title: Review Required Documents and Steps
steps.text: Review the list of required documents and steps on the City of Arvada website before beginning the application process.

steps.title: Create an Account and Apply Online
steps.text: Log in to the City of Arvada permitting system, enter the required information, and upload PDF plans and related documents to your application using the SMART License & Permits Application.

steps.title: Ensure Contractor Licensing and Sub-Contractor Listing
steps.text: Make sure you are a licensed contractor and list all sub-contractors on your permit application to avoid delays or holds.

steps.title: Submit Complete Application Package
steps.text: Submit a complete application package including all required documents. Incomplete packages may not be accepted.

steps.title: Plan Review Process
steps.text: The City of Arvada staff will review your plans for code compliance. Review timelines vary by project size and type, ranging from 8 to 14 weeks total.

steps.title: Pay Fees and Obtain Permit
steps.text: Once approved, pay all fees online or in person at the building inspections office. Download and have the permit documents available on site.

steps.title: Schedule and Pass Required Inspections
steps.text: Coordinate inspections throughout construction. Third-party inspectors handle foundation and special inspections; City staff perform other inspections.

steps.title: Obtain Certificate of Occupancy
steps.text: No space or structure may be occupied until a Certificate of Occupancy is issued after all final inspections and approvals from related departments and districts are obtained.

required_documents.name: Plan Set
required_documents.description: Each plan set must be provided individually in a single PDF, stamped by a licensed Colorado engineer or architect. Plans must include a building code summary with design assumptions and pertinent information.

required_documents.name: Civil, Landscaping and Grading Plans
required_documents.description: Include detailed civil, landscaping, and grading plans as part of the submission.

required_documents.name: Architectural Plans
required_documents.description: Provide architectural plans stamped by a licensed professional.

required_documents.name: Structural Plans
required_documents.description: Provide structural plans stamped by a licensed professional.

required_documents.name: Mechanical Plans
required_documents.description: Provide mechanical plans stamped by a licensed professional.

required_documents.name: Plumbing Plans
required_documents.description: Provide plumbing plans stamped by a licensed professional.

required_documents.name: Electrical Plans
required_documents.description: Provide electrical plans stamped by a licensed professional.

required_documents.name: COMCheck Reports
required_documents.description: Submit COMCheck reports for Building Envelope, Mechanical System, and Electrical Lighting.

required_documents.name: Plot Plan
required_documents.description: Submit a detailed site plan showing building distances, setbacks, lot coverage, dimensions, and site accessibility elements such as parking, ramps, and walks. The plot plan from the Development Process is accepted.

required_documents.name: Soils Report
required_documents.description: If applicable, provide a soils report related to structural design for the project.

required_documents.name: Asbestos Abatement Documentation
required_documents.description: If demolition is required, provide proof of compliance with Colorado Department of Public Health asbestos abatement standards.
required_documents.where_to_get: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment

required_documents.name: Fire Protection Plans
required_documents.description: Submit a separate set of plans to the applicable Fire Department for approval before permit issuance.

required_documents.name: Project Specifications
required_documents.description: If available, provide a specification manual in addition to plans.

required_documents.name: Exterior Changes Documentation
required_documents.description: Indicate any proposed exterior changes such as parking, lighting, signage, paving, glazing, awnings, mechanical equipment, and landscaping on plans and applications.

form_fields.label: Job Contract Value
form_fields.description: The total contract value of the construction project used to calculate fees.
form_fields.why_needed: Used to determine applicable permit fees.

form_fields.label: Sub-Contractors List
form_fields.description: List of all sub-contractors involved in the project.
form_fields.why_needed: Permits without sub-contractors listed will be placed on hold.

form_fields.label: Project Plans Upload
form_fields.description: Upload PDF plans including architectural, structural, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, and other required plans.
form_fields.why_needed: Required for plan review and permit approval.

form_fields.label: Plot Plan
form_fields.description: Upload detailed site plan showing building and site dimensions and accessibility features.
form_fields.why_needed: Used to verify compliance with building code and site requirements.

form_fields.label: Soils Report
form_fields.description: Upload soils report if applicable to structural design.

form_fields.label: Asbestos Abatement Compliance
form_fields.description: Provide documentation of asbestos abatement compliance if demolition is involved.

form_fields.label: Exterior Changes
form_fields.description: Indicate any proposed exterior building or site changes.
form_fields.why_needed: Needed to determine if additional Planning Division reviews are required.

timelines.review: 8 weeks for 1 to 100 sheets; 14 weeks for 100+ sheets
